name: 911 Runtime Estimator
description: Runs off an award package (folder of order folders) and estimates plate cutting time from EXACT linear inches of cut: each work order's DXF geometry / a thickness-driven feed rate, plus stock/material/thickness from each nest's work-package PDF. Writes ONE consolidated Excel workbook - Plates and Non-Plates sheets, every batch-list column plus generated columns (Division placeholder, linear inches, feed rate, Est Min/PC, Est Min/WO, Est Cut Hours) - each followed by a real, refreshable PivotTable (nest -> Sum of Est Cut Hours). Prompts for the ROOT directory at runtime.
author: Anthony Sieben

fields.label: Output Directory (optional)
fields.description: Where to save the consolidated estimate workbook. Leave blank to save inside the ROOT directory you pick at runtime.
